106:t_006:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our priority mission is to stall the enemy transports. If they reach that line, we won't be able to pursue them.」

106:t_007:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Roger...! We're breaking through the escort force!」

106:t_007:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「This is a mission entrusted to me by my beloved Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General! Let's do this!!」

106:t_008:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All enemy transports have left the area.」

106:t_008:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We... couldn't save a single person...」

106:t_009:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Pathetic, $c. Learn that with that little strength, fighting this through to the end is impossible.」

106:t_009:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let me tell you this. You can never defeat my lord, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

106:t_010:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To them it was a trivial operation... And we couldn't even stop that...」

106:t_010:4.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$スメラギ$$...! There's a transmission from the town!」

106:t_010:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Yes. The sender says their name is $$沙慈・クロスロード$$.」

106:t_011:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've succeeded in stalling all of the enemy transports.」

106:t_011:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We've achieved the bare minimum of our objective.」

106:t_012:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I'll grant you this: well done, $c. But know that with that little strength, fighting this through to the end is impossible.」

106:t_012:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let me tell you this. You can never defeat my lord, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

106:t_013:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We did it...! We did it!」

106:t_013:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「Now the $$新地球皇国$$ will have to rethink its strategy.」

106:t_013:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To them, this operation was probably just another routine mission, nothing worth a second thought.」

106:t_013:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But we had to give it everything we had just to stop it.」

106:t_013:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we keep fighting like this, sooner or later...」

106:t_013:6.en:
$n
「We have to hit $$セントラル・ベース$$ as soon as we can and drive the $$新地球皇国$$ off this continent...」

106:t_013:8.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$スメラギ$$...! There's a transmission from the transport that landed!」

106:t_013:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You mean from the residents of the town who were abducted?」

106:t_013:10.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Yes. The sender says their name is $$沙慈・クロスロード$$.」

106:t_014:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've lost track of the enemy transports that left.」

106:t_015:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Pathetic, $c. Learn that with that little strength, fighting this through to the end is impossible.」

106:t_015:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let me tell you this. You can never defeat my lord, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

106:t_016:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Even so, isn't that better than not saving anyone at all?」

106:t_016:2.en:
$$カツ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$'s right. Now the $$新地球皇国$$ will have to rethink its strategy.」

106:t_016:4.en:

「To them, this operation was probably just another routine mission, nothing worth a second thought.」

106:t_016:5.en:

106:t_016:7.en:

106:t_016:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$

106:t_016:11.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Yes. The sender says their name is $$沙慈・クロスロード$$.」

106:t_017:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The enemy transport has left the area!」

106:t_017:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The enemy ship is still accelerating! We can't pursue it!」

106:t_017:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Forget the ships that got away and focus on stalling the ones that are left! Stop as many ships as you can!」

106:t_018:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Enemy transport, engine heavily damaged! It's leaving the combat area to land!」

106:t_018:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll send my men over there! Leave the rest to me!」

106:t_018:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood, Mister $$マネキン$$! Everyone, focus on stalling the remaining ships!」

106:t_019:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Well done, $c. To think you'd corner this $$アルデバル$$.」

106:t_019:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But know that with that little strength, fighting this through to the end is impossible.」

106:t_019:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let me tell you this. You can never defeat my lord, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

106:t_020:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「And he's got the strength to match it.」

106:t_020:2.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And the Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$, the one he swears loyalty to...」

106:t_020:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The Supreme Commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces... The head of their military, then.」

106:t_020:4.en:
$n
「To bring down the Imperial forces, we have to defeat that Supreme Commander...」

106:t_100:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Let's go, $$サイデリアル$$! Completing the mission is proof of my love for the Colonel...! I show no mercy to anyone who gets in the way!」

106:t_101:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's a battleship...! If I get in close...!」

106:t_101:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Naive...! Don't think an obvious tactic like that will work against this $$アルデバル$$!」

106:t_101:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...! He's the type who enjoys fighting!?」

106:t_101:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Make your blood boil more! Put your life on the line! Challenge me with your whole body and soul!」

106:t_101:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That is the courtesy owed to one who fights the $$ハイアデス$$!!」

106:t_102:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This ship... Both its mobility and its maneuverability are different from any battleship we know...!」

106:t_102:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It's only natural that you feel that way. This $$アルデバル$$ is the arms and legs of the $$ハイアデス$$, who race across the galaxy!」

106:t_102:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The legend of the invincible $$ハイアデス$$ lives on with this $$アルデバル$$! No matter how excellent a soldier you are, your defeat is certain!」

106:t_102:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't have time to humor that self-satisfaction...! Get out of our way!」

106:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A fine machine...! But whether you can make use of it depends on the pilot!」

106:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this battleship...!? It's like a giant mobile armor!」

106:t_103:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Have you felt the power of our $$アルデバル$$ firsthand? You seem somewhat capable.」

106:t_103:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if you've noticed, it's already too late! You will be an offering to satisfy my fighting instinct!」

106:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This man... He's different from when we fought in Japan...! Is this his true nature!?」
